scope: Assigned frozen item titles and complete ItemBodies; no live routes or separate Sources footer.

review_method.normative_instructions: CLAUDE.md read fully; README.md read fully.
review_method.rendering: Every assigned local PNG tile was opened individually with tools.view_image at original resolution; no collage or downscaling. Suspected leading-glyph clipping was checked against the unchanged PNG bytes with nearest-neighbour diagnostic crops and the matching frozen title/body. No external HTTP or live website was used.
review_method.source_snapshot_html: Every frozen item title and complete ItemBody was reviewed in its snapshot and corresponding frozen HTML; current source, snapshot, HTML, and screenshot hashes were compared with the manifest and receipt records.
review_method.boundary: No item, app, or tool edits; no publication-status changes; no tests, builds, commits, pushes, or network calls. Only lane-04.json and lane-04.md are written.

optional_typography.observation: Wikilinks render on their own block lines in the preview. This is consistent across the checked items and is not counted as a rendering defect.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.exact_claim: For a fixed elimination ordering, the later-neighbor set defines the structural column C_k={v_k}∪N_k(v_k); the parent path defines descendants/ancestors and reach.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.why_warranted: A small ordered graph and its elimination forest would give a concrete visual correspondence among fill, parent edges, a structural column, and the reach of a vertex.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_maps_relations_to_draw_: Use one small graph with vertex positions explicitly ordered by π. Show the source convention parent edges from child v_k to its later parent, identify N_k(v_k), shade C_k={v_k}∪N_k(v_k), and highlight the parent path including v_k as its reach. Avoid implying that arbitrary graph edges are parent edges or that the forest orientation reverses the increasing elimination order.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.certainty: uncertain optional candidate; source lines 28–30 define these relations but give no worked graph. No proof depends on a diagram.

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.exact_claim: The algorithm computes upward coefficients on the column cluster tree, accumulates admissible and near-leaf interactions, then propagates row coefficients downward before leaf basis expansion.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.kind: Optional TikZ pair of nested-cluster traversal diagrams
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.why_warranted: The upward and downward passes, interaction lists, and leaf-local near field are easier to follow as a traversal map than as three procedural paragraphs.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.specific_content_maps_relations_to_draw_: Draw the column tree with child-to-parent arrows labeled (E^V_{σ_j})*, leaf projections V_σ* x|_σ, and admissible block couplings S_{τσ} feeding row-cluster coefficients. Draw near-field D_{τσ}x|_σ directly into y|_τ. Draw the row tree with parent-to-child arrows labeled E^U_{τ_i}, then leaf expansion U_τw_τ. Keep all arrows and coefficients matched to the source; do not reverse the adjoint on the upward pass or omit near-leaf contributions.
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.certainty: uncertain optional candidate; every arrow and contribution follows source lines 36–40, and the algorithm is already explicit in prose.

diagram_review.reason: All assigned screenshot sidecars report tikz_count 0 and diagram_failures []. No existing TikZ/tikzcd content diagrams were available for mathematical label/map/orientation/index/sign review. Optional candidates above are source-grounded explanatory additions.

scratch_review.result: No Scratch section or Scratch disclosure occurs in any assigned ItemBody; no Scratch panel required opening.
